name: jupytergis-core
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.16.0"
  build_number: 0
  python_min: "3.12"

recipe:
  name: jupytergis-packages
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - target_directory: jupytergis_core
    url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jupytergis_core/jupytergis_core-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 015afe08bfa5c718c6f8cc5023f7b7b27993d78054d74380076aeffe2469336f
  - target_directory: jupytergis_lab
    url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jupytergis_lab/jupytergis_lab-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 3f8467e95d097c8c3a796aaf1e554fce79eebf3ba9c516df40d259342a90b40e
  - target_directory: jupytergis_qgis
    url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jupytergis_qgis/jupytergis_qgis-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 9386bc076e96906f8e148ac6a770ccef10d153c913291dec088ffcccd7dfa4c4
  - target_directory: jupytergis_lite
    url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jupytergis_lite/jupytergis_lite-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 4336f3327cbc68c465ff311a9252b75881a4607011cda6ba6369c4b820fd7fa7
  - target_directory: jupytergis
    url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jupytergis/jupytergis-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: e59bc645a569bcc6fd03a731d6e3a406268f43affe1e4d1b02aa1ca0175f3041

build:
  noarch: python
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  - package:
      name: jupytergis-core
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: |
        cd jupytergis_core
        python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --ignore-installed --no-index
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
        - yarn
        - jupyterlab >=4.6
        - hatch-jupyter-builder
        - hatch-nodejs-version >=0.3.2
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - jupyter_ydoc >=2,<4
        - branca >=0.6
        - webcolors
      run_constraints:
        - jupyterlab >=4.6
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
          imports:
            - jupytergis_core
          pip_check: true
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - share/jupyter/labextensions/@jupytergis/jupytergis-core/package.json

  - package:
      name: jupytergis-lab
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: |
        cd jupytergis_lab
        python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --ignore-installed --no-index
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
        - yarn
        - jupyterlab >=4.6
        - hatch-jupyter-builder
        - hatch-nodejs-version >=0.3.2
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis-core", exact=True) }}
        - requests
        - jupyter_ydoc >=2,<4
        - ypywidgets >=0.9.0,<0.10
        - yjs-widgets >=0.6,<0.7
        - comm >=0.1.2,<0.2
        - pydantic >=2,<3
        - sidecar >=0.7.0
        - py2vega >=0.7.0
      run_constraints:
        - jupyterlab >=4.6
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
          imports:
            - jupytergis_lab.notebook.gis_document
          pip_check: true
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - share/jupyter/labextensions/@jupytergis/jupytergis-lab/package.json

  - package:
      name: jupytergis-qgis
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: |
        cd jupytergis_qgis
        python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --ignore-installed --no-index
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
        - yarn
        - jupyterlab >=4.6
        - hatch-jupyter-builder
        - hatch-nodejs-version >=0.3.2
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis-core", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis-lab", exact=True) }}
        - jupyter_server >=2.0.1,<3
        - jupyter_ydoc >=2,<4
      run_constraints:
        - jupyterlab >=4.6
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
          pip_check: true
      - script:
          - python -c "import jupytergis_qgis.qgis_loader"
        requirements:
          run:
            - qgis

  - package:
      name: jupytergis-lite
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: |
        cd jupytergis_lite
        python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --ignore-installed --no-index
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis-core", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis-lab", exact=True) }}
        - my-jupyter-shared-drive >=0.2.2
        - jupyterlab-tour >=4,<5
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
          imports:
            - jupytergis
          pip_check: true

  - package:
      name: jupytergis
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: |
        cd jupytergis
        python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --ignore-installed --no-index
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis-core", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis-lab", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis-qgis", exact=True) }}
        - jupyter-collaboration >=4,<5
        - jupyter-collaboration-ui >=2,<3
        - jupyter-docprovider >=2,<3
        - jupyter_server_ydoc >=2,<3
        - jupyterlab-tour >=4,<5
      run_constraints:
        - jupyterlab >=4.6
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
          imports:
            - jupytergis
          pip_check: true

  - package:
      name: jupytergis-tiler
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupytergis", exact=True) }}
        - jupyter-tiler >=0.8.0
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
          imports:
            - jupyter_tiler

about:
  summary: A JupyterLab extension for collaborative GIS
  description: |
    jupytergis is a JupyterLab extension for GIS with collaborative editing support. It is designed to allow multiple people to work on the same file at the same time, and to facilitate discussion and collaboration around the GIS visualization being created.
    jupytergis has support for QGIS files, which makes it easy to import and export models from QGIS. It also has a range of features for creating and manipulating layers.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: jupytergis/LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/geojupyter/jupytergis
  documentation: https://jupytergis.readthedocs.io/en/latest
  repository: https://github.com/geojupyter/jupytergis

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - arjxn-py
    - mfisher87
    - martinRenou
